title: Stellaluna
author: Janell Cannon
intro: Stellaluna is a baby fruit bat. She lives with her mother.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What kind of animal is Stellaluna?
questions.clue: She likes to hang upside down.
questions.yes: Stellaluna is a baby fruit bat.

questions.q: Who attacks the bats one night?
questions.clue: It is a bird that hunts at night.

questions.q: What happens to Stellaluna when the owl attacks?

options.text: She flies up to the moon
She hides in a dark, deep cave

questions.clue: She drops down into the forest below.
questions.yes: Stellaluna fell from her mother into the forest.
Stellaluna landed in a nest of baby birds.

questions.q: What are the three baby birds called?
questions.clue: One of them is called Pip.
questions.yes: The baby birds are Pip, Flitter and Flap.

questions.q: What does Mama Bird say Stellaluna must eat?
questions.yes: Mama Bird said Stellaluna must eat bugs and worms.

questions.q: When must Stellaluna sleep, says Mama Bird?
questions.clue: Birds sleep when it is dark.
questions.yes: Mama Bird said Stellaluna must sleep at night.

questions.q: What else must Stellaluna stop doing?

options.text: Hanging upside down by her feet

questions.clue: Bats like to hang this way, but birds do not.
questions.yes: Mama Bird said Stellaluna must stop hanging upside down.

questions.q: Why do the birds fly home without Stellaluna?

options.text: They cannot see in the dark
They want to eat their dinner

questions.yes: The birds could not see in the dark.

questions.q: How does Stellaluna hang when she stops to rest?
questions.clue: She uses her hands, not her feet.
questions.yes: Stellaluna rested hanging by her thumbs.

questions.q: Who finds Stellaluna while she tells the bats her story?
questions.clue: It is the bat who lost her at the start.

questions.q: Who does Stellaluna go back to visit?
questions.clue: She wants to tell them all about bats.
questions.yes: Stellaluna went back to see Pip, Flitter and Flap.

questions.q: What happens when the birds try to fly at night?
questions.clue: Birds cannot see well in the dark.
questions.yes: The birds nearly crashed, and Stellaluna rescued them.

questions.q: What do Stellaluna and the birds decide at the end?

options.text: They will all live in a cave

questions.clue: They are very different, but they care about each other.
questions.yes: They decided they are friends, even though they are very different.
